This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.254/2022, dated 06.08.2022, registered at Police Station Batiyagarh, District Damoh (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 366A,
376(2)(n), 346, 506 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: 2. Applicant's first bail application was dismissed for want of prosecution vide order dated 40100 of 2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned counsel for the respondent No.2/victim have submitted that parties have entered into compromise and now, they are blessed with one child.

4. As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this second bail application too under Section 438 of Cr.P.C for grant of anticipatory bail filed o n behalf of applicant - Ramkumar i s dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

5. However, as prayed, it is directed that if applicant surrenders and prefers an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail before the trial Court, same may be considered and decided expeditiously preferably on the same day.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Ramkumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57035329/
